messages:
tia: Quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today

tia: Done: rolled the kv-evict change to staging, verified no latency spike in the 95th p99 window.
tia: Blocker: still seeing sporadic 503s from the batcher when concurrency hits ~120 — need more traces.
tia: Today: will add extra logging around request fanout and run a targeted canary against /v1/generate at low load.

jordan: Noted. Can you paste the tracer id for the last 503? I can pull the span.
jordan: Also, I'm going to tune alert debounce — we're getting noisy alerts for `batcher-503` during warmup.

tia: tracer id: a1f4c9d2 — logs attached (small snippet):
```
2026-03-17T06:12:03Z batcher request failed status=503 retry=0 span=a1f4c9d2
2026-03-17T06:12:03Z upstream grpc error: deadline exceeded
```

lee: Checked SLO dashboard: rolling 7d p99 latency is 120ms, p95 steady at 75ms. But the error budget for batcher-frontend is down to 3%.
lee: Suggest we pause wide rollouts until we get the 503 root cause — maybe decrease concurrency or enable per-model throttling.

sam: FYI I put a brief note in the ops runbook under `batcher/known-issues` with mitigation steps (link: https://dash.redwood.com/runbooks/batcher).
sam: I can handle temp throttling if you want, tia — just give me the target qps.

tia: Thanks. Can we try capping concurrent-requests=100 on canary next 30m and monitor? If stable I'll roll to prod.

jordan: +1. I'll adjust alerting to only page on >5% 5m error rate (instead of current 2%). Will post the change here once applied.

ops-bot: deploy started: `kv-evict-change` -> canary (pods: 2/2). CI: passed. (diff: https://git.redwood.com/infra/commit/abc123) :rocket:

pagerduty-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0323 — batcher 503 spikes (severity: low). Assigned: @jordan.

lee: Quick note on observability: I'll add a histogram for backend queue time to the slo dashboard to catch queue buildup earlier. Should be visible within 10m.

tia: Great. Blocker update: I'll run a short load test against the canary at 80qps and share results. If 503s persist, we'll capture full trace dump and escalate.

sam: Ping me when you start the test and I'll watch the autoscaler + nodes.

jordan: Alert tuning change applied: paging threshold bumped to 5% 5m errors for `batcher-503`. Monitoring for missed pages for 2h before finalizing.

tia: Thanks team. I'll post results in this thread within the hour. :white_check_mark:
